_comment: Single source of truth: which BUSINESS WhatsApp number (the number a customer TEXTS, i.e. value.metadata.display_phone_number on the webhook — not the customer's own number) triggers which scripted flow. IMPORTANT: WhatsApp delivers this as the FULL international number without '+', so +91-98998-60983 always arrives as '919899860983' (NOT the bare 10-digit form). A number can own only one flow at a time. TESTING NOW with only one business number wired up, 919899860983 → Subway; Kia is parked on an unused number. To test Kia instead, swap the two values. FINAL two-number setup: subway=918328145692, kia=919899860983. Env vars SUBWAY_PHONE / KIA_PHONE override these. Restart after editing.
